ladder.subject: High bridges, walking or driving across

contexts.safe: A wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight, featuring an empty pedestrian walkway with concrete barriers and metal railings. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A pedestrian walks onto the sidewalk from the distant approach.
contexts.exit: The pedestrian walks backward off the sidewalk toward the distant approach.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands on the sidewalk of a wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A pedestrian walks onto the sidewalk from the distant approach.
levels.down: The pedestrian walks backward off the sidewalk toward the distant approach.
holds: The pedestrian looks at the river below.
The pedestrian takes a slow breath.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands on the sidewalk of a wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight, positioned near a support cable. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian walks forward ten paces along the metal grating.
levels.down: The pedestrian walks backward ten paces to the previous spot.
holds: The pedestrian rests a hand on the metal railing.
The pedestrian watches a boat pass underneath.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands beside the metal railing of a wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian steps closer to the outer edge of the walkway.
levels.down: The pedestrian steps back toward the center of the walkway.
holds: The pedestrian turns the head to look straight ahead.
The pedestrian stands completely still by the railing.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands directly beside the outer metal railing of a wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian reaches out to touch the vertical steel cable.
levels.down: The pedestrian lowers the hand back down to the side.
holds: The pedestrian holds the metal cable gently.
The pedestrian blinks in the bright sunlight.

levels.state: A pedestrian holds the vertical steel cable of a wide steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river under bright daylight. Extreme close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian leans slightly toward the open space above the river.
levels.down: The pedestrian straightens posture back away from the edge.
holds: The pedestrian maintains a steady grip on the railing.
The pedestrian breathes evenly in the open air.

contexts.safe: A high concrete viaduct curving across a green valley under bright daylight, featuring an empty wide pedestrian path and solid concrete walls. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A pedestrian steps onto the curved pathway from the entry ramp.
contexts.exit: The pedestrian steps backward off the curved pathway toward the entry ramp.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands on the curved pathway of a high concrete viaduct spanning a green valley under bright daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A pedestrian steps onto the curved pathway from the entry ramp.
levels.down: The pedestrian steps backward off the curved pathway toward the entry ramp.
holds: The pedestrian looks across the wide green valley.
The pedestrian stands balanced on both feet.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands on the curved pathway of a high concrete viaduct spanning a green valley under bright daylight, near a low safety wall. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian walks forward toward the center span.
levels.down: The pedestrian walks backward toward the entry ramp.
holds: The pedestrian checks the view of the valley below.
The pedestrian adjusts a jacket pocket.

levels.state: A pedestrian stands beside the low safety wall of a high concrete viaduct spanning a green valley under bright daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian moves closer to the concrete wall edge.
levels.down: The pedestrian moves away from the concrete wall edge.
holds: The pedestrian rests fingertips on the concrete top.
The pedestrian listens to the wind sound.

levels.state: A pedestrian rests fingertips on the concrete safety wall of a high concrete viaduct spanning a green valley under bright daylight. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian leans both forearms onto the concrete wall top.
levels.down: The pedestrian lifts the forearms off the concrete wall top.
holds: The pedestrian gazes steadily at the horizon.
The pedestrian keeps a relaxed posture.

levels.state: A pedestrian leans forearms on the concrete safety wall of a high concrete viaduct spanning a green valley under bright daylight. Extreme close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, shallow depth of field.
levels.up: The pedestrian shifts weight forward against the wall safely.
levels.down: The pedestrian shifts weight backward onto both heels.
holds: The pedestrian remains calm against the safety wall.
The pedestrian looks at the distant hills.

ev.fearedOutcome: I'll lose control near the edge
ev.prompt: The pedestrian stands securely by the bridge railing while the wind blows gently.

deepened: The wind gusts slightly stronger against the bridge railing.
